issues.legal_issue: A land acquisition proceeding is not invalid merely because an interested person did not receive an individual notice of the preliminary intention to acquire when the required public notice was given.
material_facts: The respondents were tenants of acquired land and had erected structures on it at their own expense.
They said they received no individual notice and learned of the acquisition only when their landlord told them that possession was to be handed over.
The acquisition notification was published in the Official Gazette, and the substance of the notification was publicly posted at a convenient place in the locality.
The acquisition authorities also served notices on persons known or believed to be interested, and compliance with the public-notice procedure was not disputed.
The respondents challenged the acquisition proceedings and award, and the High Court set them aside because the respondents had not been individually notified.
issues.conclusion: The absence of individual notice to each interested person did not invalidate the acquisition proceedings; the appeal was allowed and the High Court’s judgment and decree were set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 requires publication in the Official Gazette and public notice of the substance of the notification at convenient places in the locality; Rule 1 of the rules made under section 55 does not add a requirement of personal notice to every interested person. The Court approved Bai Malimabu v. State of Gujarat, which interpreted the similar Rule 30-B consistently with that principle, and overruled Ashokkumar Gordhanbhai v. State of Gujarat; it also noted the consistent view in Vasudev Chunilal Pancholi v. State of Gujarat.

rule.if: land_acquisition_proceeding and official_publication_given and locality_public_notice_given and individual_notice_absent

predicates.land_acquisition_proceeding: The challenged proceeding sought to acquire land for a public purpose.
predicates.official_publication_given: The acquisition notification was published through the prescribed official publication method.
predicates.locality_public_notice_given: The substance of the acquisition notification was publicly communicated at a convenient place in the affected locality.
predicates.individual_notice_absent: An interested person did not receive a separate personal notice of the acquisition notification.

issues.definition: When a land acquisition proceeding uses the prescribed official and local public-notice methods, the absence of a separate personal notice does not make the proceeding invalid.
